# TruRando — llms.txt
# Free random group and team generator for teachers and coaches.
# https://trurando.trujoedigital.com/

## What TruRando is

TruRando is a free, privacy-first web tool that randomly assigns people into
groups and deals out topics. Teachers use it to split a class roster into
random groups; coaches use it to draft fair teams. There is no account, no
login, no analytics, and no server: the entire app runs in the visitor's
browser, so a class roster or team list never leaves the device it was pasted
into.

## Key features

- Paste a list of names (one per line); the app cleans up pasted "worksheet
  chrome" automatically — numbered lists, titles, timestamps, headers,
  footers, and page markers are stripped so only real names remain.
- Choose group size or number of groups; TruRando deals names out randomly.
- Reroll / reshuffle as many times as needed.
- Topic assignment mode: randomly deal discussion topics or tasks to groups.
- OCR import: snap a photo of a printed roster and extract the names.
- Export results (copy or download).
- Junk-line filter keeps misspelled real names while dropping non-name lines.
- Confetti celebration on reveal (optional, dismissible).
- Works offline-capable once loaded; no data ever transmitted.

## Privacy

- No accounts, no logins, no cookies for tracking, no analytics beacons.
- No localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB use for roster data.
- Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; all scripts self-hosted.
- See PRIVACY.md for the full privacy statement.

## Who it is for

- Teachers splitting classes into random groups or assigning topics.
- Coaches drafting fair, randomized teams.
- Workshop facilitators and organizers forming breakout groups.

## Cost

- Free. No premium tier, no paywall, no ads inside the randomizer.

## Maker

- Built by TruJoe Digital (https://trujoedigital.com), Clarksville, Arkansas.
